ece-r100.title: UN Regulation No. 100 — Vehicles with Regard to Specific Requirements for the Electric Power Train
ece-r100._why: Finding ece-r100/title: official UNECE title is 'approval of vehicles with regard to specific requirements for the electric power train'; record had a garbled title.

ece-r114.title: UN Regulation No. 114 — Replacement Airbag Modules, Replacement Steering Wheels with Airbag and Replacement Airbag Systems
ece-r114.summary: UN R114 covers the approval of replacement (aftermarket) airbag equipment: airbag modules for a replacement airbag system, replacement steering wheels fitted with an approved airbag module, and replacement airbag systems other than those installed in a steering wheel. It applies to M1 and N1 vehicles.
ece-r114._why: Findings ece-r114/title and summary: R114 is about replacement airbag equipment, not original-equipment airbag systems; current summary is a placeholder.

ece-r44.status_note: UN R129 (i-Size) is the successor child restraint regulation; ending new approvals to UN R44 has been proposed at WP.29 (target Sept 2027). R44 remains in force for existing approvals.
ece-r44._why: Finding ece-r44/status: keep in-force, add successor note; EU 2024 sale-ban date is from secondary sources and deliberately omitted.

ece-r89._why: Finding ece-r89/vehicle_categories: ASLD provisions apply to all M and N categories, SLD to M2, M3, N2, N3; M1/N1 map to Passenger car/Light truck.
